author: tree lineage BENCH builder run a0034a1c20bdb097d, edited by the Conductor in 0c1592e2d7 and by BENCH Designer runs bench-ek3-st3-20261113 and bench-ek3-st3b-20261113

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands one cell from a colonist crouched behind a sandbag line. The colonist sails about three cells away from the impact, clean over the sandbags, and lands on the grass alive, dazed for a moment.
scenarios.expect: accept: a shell beside a colonist throws them about three cells over sandbags, alive and briefly stunned

scenarios.text: A grenade throws a raider toward a cell another raider steps into mid-flight. Halfway through the air the thrown raider swerves and lands on a different, empty cell off to the side.
scenarios.expect: reject: a thrown pawn goes to the cell chosen at the blast and is never re-targeted

scenarios.text: A frag grenade throws a colonist into the stone wall of the kitchen. She hits the wall, bounces back two cells into the room and slides to a stop.
scenarios.expect: reject: a thrown person stops dead at a wall and takes an impact hit; people never rebound

scenarios.text: A modder's rocket has its projectile throw set to zero, while its bomb damage type throws normally. The rocket explodes beside two raiders and neither of them moves.
scenarios.expect: accept: the projectile's tuning wins over the damage type, and zero turns the throw off

scenarios.text: A launcher whose own tuning caps its throw at two cells fires into a group of pirates. One pirate standing right beside the impact is thrown five cells across the yard.
scenarios.expect: reject: a weapon's own maximum caps its throw

scenarios.text: A weapon tuned with an impact factor of 0 throws a raider into a closed wooden door. The raider stops before the door unhurt, and the door shows no damage.
scenarios.expect: accept: an impact factor of 0 makes throws hit doors harmlessly, the door undamaged

scenarios.text: A grav-ram, whose own creature mass limit is 216 kg, strikes beside a 180 kg rhino. The rhino is thrown along the blast, even though an ordinary grenade at the default settings would leave it standing.
scenarios.expect: accept: a weapon's own creature mass limit (the grav-ram's 216 kg) lets it throw a living pawn heavier than the 150 kg default but under its own limit

scenarios.text: With Mod Settings at their defaults, an ordinary frag grenade goes off right under a 240 kg thrumbo. The thrumbo is hurled several cells across the field.
scenarios.expect: reject: a living creature heavier than the 150 kg creature mass limit (the default) is never thrown, and the thrumbo is over it

scenarios.text: A grenade lands in a workshop beside a finished stone sculpture weighing well over 75 kg. The sculpture flies off the floor and spins into the corner.
scenarios.expect: reject: goods heavier than the 75 kg mass limit are never thrown

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands beside the corpse of a megasloth lying in the field, several hundred kilograms of it. The huge corpse is flung four cells and tumbles to a stop.
scenarios.expect: reject: a corpse heavier than the 75 kg goods mass limit is never thrown; a corpse is weighed by the goods limit alone, no body-size rule remains

scenarios.text: A grenade kills a raider standing in a narrow corridor. His corpse flies off in a high spinning arc, strikes the corridor wall, bounces back a little slower and settles.
scenarios.expect: accept: a pawn the blast kills flies among the goods, high arc, spin, rebounds keeping about 70 percent

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands behind a raider standing at the edge of an open pit. The raider is thrown toward the pit and drops to its floor.
scenarios.expect: accept: anything thrown toward an open pit falls to its floor

scenarios.text: A grenade throws a pirate toward a wide open pit between him and the colony wall. He flies over the pit and lands on the far rim, unhurt.
scenarios.expect: reject: nothing is thrown across a pit; it falls to the floor

scenarios.text: A colonist carrying steel to the stockpile takes the shortest route, which crosses an open pit. She walks straight onto the pit cell and drops onto its floor.
scenarios.expect: reject: no colonist walks into a pit by ordinary pathing

scenarios.text: A raider steps onto a covered pit trap and a grenade lands on the cell next to it, not on the cover, within its radius. The cover breaks and the raider falls in.
scenarios.expect: accept: a damaging blast reaching a covered pit, on it or beside it within its radius, breaks the cover and whoever is on it falls

scenarios.text: A smoke grenade lands right on a covered pit trap with a raider standing on it. The cover shatters and the raider drops into the pit.
scenarios.expect: reject: an EMP, smoke or stun burst never breaks a pit cover

scenarios.text: A raider with a shield belt stands in a drifting flammable gas cloud when a spark lights it. The burst next to him shoves him one cell, his belt doing nothing to stop it, and he takes no harm.
scenarios.expect: accept: a gas clump shoves a pawn one cell unhurt and a shield belt does not stop the shove

scenarios.text: A flammable gas cloud filling a storeroom catches. The whole cloud goes off at once as one big blast at its middle, burning the colonists inside and throwing them three cells.
scenarios.expect: reject: a lit gas cloud goes off clump by clump, shoving people one cell unhurt, never one centroid blast

scenarios.text: A sniper's bullet hits a raider in the chest. The raider is knocked backwards two cells and lies stunned.
scenarios.expect: reject: only explosions throw; bullets move nobody

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands in a storeroom two cells from a Deep Storage weapons locker holding rifles, about 100 kg with its rifles, the floor cell behind the locker empty. The locker slides one cell away from the blast and every rifle stays inside it.
scenarios.expect: accept: a closed container (a modded locker that does not draw its contents) keeps its goods and, 1x1, at or under the 250 kg container mass limit and with a free cell behind it, slides one cell

scenarios.text: A grenade goes off beside a Deep Storage weapons locker packed with rifles. The locker's rifles burst out and scatter across the room.
scenarios.expect: reject: closed containers keep their goods

scenarios.text: A mortar shell hits a storeroom with goods on the floor and on open shelves. The floor goods fly everywhere, but every stack on the shelves sits untouched.
scenarios.expect: reject: open shelves protect nothing; their goods scatter like floor goods

scenarios.text: The player lowers the goods mass limit in Mod Settings to 20 kg. The next grenade into the stockpile throws the light stacks of cloth and herbal medicine but leaves a 30 kg stack where it was, and still throws the colonist standing beside it.
scenarios.expect: accept: every Mod Settings line takes effect, the goods mass limit among them (it weighs goods and corpses, never a living pawn), with the rest still working

scenarios.text: An incendiary shell from another mod lands among a pirate squad. Fire spreads over the ground, but not one pirate is moved.
scenarios.expect: reject: every harmful explosion throws, fire at half strength, other mods too

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands in the middle of a crowded stockpile of about sixty light stacks. The stacks nearest the impact fly off spinning and bounce around the room. A row of cloth and steel stacks a few cells out, still well inside the blast and each due to be pushed a couple of cells, sits exactly where it was.
scenarios.expect: reject: every light good reached with a throw of a cell or more must move; nothing is skipped over a cap

scenarios.text: A grenade goes off in a workshop full of components and silver. Most stacks arc away spinning, but one stack of silver blinks out of its cell and is simply there on a cell four tiles away, a puff of dust marking the spot.
scenarios.expect: reject: goods never vanish and reappear under a dust puff; every good must fly

scenarios.text: A frag grenade lands in a storeroom beside an open shelf holding six stacks of medicine and meals. The floor goods scatter across the room. Two stacks from the shelf tumble off, while the other four stay on the shelf, apparently sheltered by it.
scenarios.expect: reject: open shelves protect nothing; their goods scatter like floor goods

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands beside a Deep Storage weapons locker of rifles with empty floor behind it. The locker slides one cell, and as it settles two rifles spill from it onto the floor beside it, the rest staying inside.
scenarios.expect: reject: a closed container keeps its goods; only the container itself may be shoved

scenarios.text: A grenade throws a raider into the stone wall of a corridor. He stops at the cell before the wall and takes a hit, then eases back a half step into the corridor before he settles, stunned.
scenarios.expect: reject: a thrown person stops dead at a wall and never rebounds, even slightly

scenarios.text: A raider is standing beside a closed pit trap when a burning gas cloud goes off near him. The burst shoves him one cell onto the cover, which gives way under him, and he drops into the pit.
scenarios.expect: reject: a gas burst never breaks a cover; a pawn it shoves onto a cover stands on it, the cover whole

scenarios.text: A grenade throws a heavy stack of steel toward a pit trap whose cover is still in place. The stack lands on the covered cell and rests there on top of the cover, which stays whole.
scenarios.expect: reject: a thing thrown onto a covered cell falls through and breaks the cover

scenarios.text: A colonist is caught in a long flammable gas cloud that catches fire. The bursts run through the cloud clump by clump; she is shoved one cell unhurt, and the very next clump half a second later shoves her another cell, then another.
scenarios.expect: reject: a person is shoved at most once every 2 seconds by the gas

scenarios.text: A grenade goes off in a stockpile. Near stacks fly off spinning, but a stack of wood at the very rim of the blast, which would have been pushed less than a cell, does not move at all.
scenarios.expect: accept: a thing at the rim whose throw is under one cell is spared

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands beside a Deep Storage weapons locker standing against a wall, the wall directly behind it. The locker does not slide but jolts in place, and every rifle inside stays inside.
scenarios.expect: accept: a closed container may slide one cell or jolt; never into a wall, and its goods stay in

scenarios.text: The Cauldron has been venting its gas into a cramped workshop with steel and herbal medicine lying on the floor. A burning torch on the wall sets the edge of the cloud alight. Small bursts walk across the room one after another as the flames move through, each one flinging the nearby stacks, and the smith at the bench is pushed one cell sideways without a scratch.
scenarios.expect: accept: the Cauldron's gas, touched by fire, goes off clump by clump, scattering goods and shoving a person one cell unhurt

scenarios.text: The Cauldron's gas pools in a corner of the storeroom. A campfire burns four cells away, never reaching the cloud. A few seconds later the cloud starts bursting anyway, scattering the stacks around it.
scenarios.expect: reject: a gas cloud catches only from a fire touching it; a fire a few cells away lights nothing

scenarios.text: A fire spreads into the Cauldron's gas cloud in the brewing hall. The cloud flares up and burns as ordinary flames over the floor; nothing bursts, and the bottles and cloth beside it stay exactly where they lay.
scenarios.expect: reject: the Cauldron's gas must go off clump by clump, not burn as plain fire with no bursts

scenarios.text: One of our machines puts out a drift of tox gas across the yard, and a burning wall lamp touches the edge of it. The gas just hangs there poisoning anyone who stays; no bursts go off and the goods in it do not move.
scenarios.expect: accept: tox gas our code adds is vanilla gas that does not burn; only gas the census tags as flammable goes off

scenarios.text: A building of ours sends vanilla smoke over the stockpile, and a grass fire runs into the smoke. Bursts go off through the smoke one after another, throwing the stacks around and pushing a hauler one cell.
scenarios.expect: reject: vanilla smoke our code adds does not burn; only gas the census tags as flammable goes off clump by clump

scenarios.text: A grenade goes off in a hallway full of loose components. The stacks fly up in a high spinning arc, clear a line of sandbags, hit the closed door at the end, bounce back slower, glance off the side wall slower again, and roll to a stop.
scenarios.expect: accept: goods arc, spin, pass over sandbags and rebound off walls and closed doors losing about 30 percent each time until spent

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands in a storeroom. A stack of cloth flies up spinning in a high arc toward the closed wooden door, strikes it and drops straight down on the cell in front of it, where it stays.
scenarios.expect: reject: goods rebound off closed doors keeping about 70 percent of their speed; stopping at the first door is the wall-stop rule for people, not goods

scenarios.text: A grenade explodes on a riverbank beside a pile of silver. Part of the pile spins out over the deep water, splashes in and is gone; the player cannot find it anywhere afterwards.
scenarios.expect: reject: goods stop short of deep water and are never lost or hidden in it

scenarios.text: A frag grenade blows a stack of medicine into a small stone room. It arcs up spinning and bounces between the walls, ricocheting off each one as fast as it hit it, back and forth half a dozen times before it finally drops.
scenarios.expect: reject: each rebound keeps only about 70 percent of the speed, so the good slows at every wall rather than bouncing undiminished

scenarios.text: A frag grenade throws a colonist across the kitchen toward its stone wall. She stops on the cell right before the wall, takes a hit from the impact, and lies there stunned on that same cell.
scenarios.expect: accept: a thrown person stops dead at a wall with an impact hit and never rebounds

scenarios.text: A grenade throws a raider across the yard. While he is still in the air, a second grenade goes off right under his flight path. He carries on along his first arc to the cell he was aimed at and lands there.
scenarios.expect: accept: a pawn already airborne is never thrown again; the flight keeps the cell chosen at the first blast

scenarios.text: A frag grenade hurls a colonist toward the barracks. Mid-flight a mortar shell lands beside her and she jerks sideways in the air, flying off three more cells in a new direction before landing.
scenarios.expect: reject: a pawn already airborne is never thrown by another blast

scenarios.text: A grenade lands in the dining room beside a table set with simple meals. The meals fly off the table in spinning arcs and scatter across the floor, leaving the table bare.
scenarios.expect: accept: goods on an open table scatter like floor goods and the table is emptied

scenarios.text: A mortar shell hits a workshop. Components lying on the floor fly in every direction, but the stacks of steel and medicine on the small shelf by the door stay exactly where they were.
scenarios.expect: reject: a small shelf is open storage and protects nothing; its goods must scatter like floor goods

scenarios.text: A grenade goes off beside a sealed crate of silver standing at the lip of an open pit, the pit on the far side of the crate from the blast. The crate slides one cell straight over the edge and drops to the pit floor with its silver.
scenarios.expect: reject: a closed container (a sealed crate) may shift a cell or jolt but is never shoved into a pit

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands beside a Deep Storage weapons locker full of rifles, with a colonist standing on the cell right behind it. The locker does not move off its cell but shudders in place, and every rifle stays inside.
scenarios.expect: accept: with the cell behind taken by a pawn a 1x1 closed container jolts in place, contents kept

scenarios.text: The player switches off the fire-at-half part in Mod Settings and reloads the colony. An incendiary shell lands among a pirate squad; the fire spreads and each pirate is pushed a cell or so away from the impact.
scenarios.expect: reject: with fire at half switched off, fire and incendiary blasts throw nothing, as shipped today

scenarios.text: A colonist is dragging a hose end across the yard when a grenade throws him four cells. The hose end lies on the cell where he was standing, and he lands empty-handed.
scenarios.expect: accept: a thrown carrier drops the hose end on the cell they were thrown from

scenarios.text: A grenade lands in the kitchen beside the hopper that feeds the nutrient paste dispenser, the hopper full of raw rice. The rice is blown out of the hopper and scatters across the kitchen floor, leaving the hopper empty.
scenarios.expect: accept: a hopper draws its contents, so it is open and protects nothing; its goods scatter like floor goods

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands in a barn beside a hopper of corn. The loose hay on the floor flies in every direction, but the corn in the hopper stays exactly where it was.
scenarios.expect: reject: a hopper is open storage (it draws its contents) and protects nothing; its corn must scatter like the floor goods

scenarios.text: A grenade goes off beside an ancient security crate, the big two-by-two kind, holding gold, with open floor behind it. The whole crate slides a cell away from the blast, the gold still inside.
scenarios.expect: reject: only a 1x1 closed container may slide; one larger than 1x1 stays on its cells and jolts in place

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands beside a 500 kg Deep Storage safe full of silver, with empty floor behind it. The safe slides a full cell across the floor, its silver still locked inside.
scenarios.expect: reject: a 1x1 closed container slides only at or under the 250 kg container mass limit; the 500 kg safe is over it and only jolts in place

scenarios.text: A grenade goes off in the freezer beside a modded fridge that shows its meals stacked on its shelves. The meals are blown out of the fridge and scatter across the floor.
scenarios.expect: accept: anything that draws its contents is open, a drawing fridge among them, so its goods scatter

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands beside a modded gun locker that displays its rifles on its face. The floor goods around it fly, but the locker only shudders in place and every rifle stays in it.
scenarios.expect: reject: a locker that draws its contents is open, period; its rifles must scatter like floor goods, not be held

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands beside a sealed crate of components with a colonist standing on the cell directly behind it. The crate shudders on its cell without moving off it, the colonist is not pushed by it, and every component stays inside the crate.
scenarios.expect: accept: a sealed crate is a closed container and keeps its goods; with a pawn behind it, it jolts in place, never shoved onto a pawn

scenarios.text: A raider's grenade lands in the middle of a big stockpile of light stacks, some seventy of them inside the blast and each due to be pushed at least a cell. About forty stacks fly off spinning; the other thirty stay on their cells.
scenarios.expect: reject: every light loose good reached with a throw of a cell or more moves; the 40-throw cap is removed and nothing is skipped over a cap

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands in a twelve-by-twelve stockpile packed with one light stack per cell, three haulers working among them. Every stack the blast reaches flies, more than sixty of them, none left sitting, and all three haulers are thrown.
scenarios.expect: accept: every light loose good the blast reaches with a throw of a cell or more moves, however many, and every colonist reached is thrown

scenarios.text: A raider's sonic grenade from the Outer Rim mod goes off two cells from a colonist. She is thrown off her feet through the air away from it and lands stunned.
scenarios.expect: accept: another mod's damaging explosion throws too (an untuned type at the other-mods percent, 100 by default)

scenarios.text: An EMP grenade goes off among a group of mechanoids and the colonists fighting them. Every mech and colonist inside the burst is thrown a couple of cells away from it.
scenarios.expect: reject: harmless bursts such as EMP throw nothing

scenarios.text: The player has set the other-mods percent in Mod Settings to 50. An Outer Rim plasma grenade, whose damage type is ordinary Flame, goes off two cells from a raider, and he is thrown only about a quarter as far as a frag grenade at the same distance throws his comrade.
scenarios.expect: reject: a modded blast of a damage type our patch already tunes (fire, at half) keeps that tuning; the other-mods percent applies only to an untuned type and is never stacked on it, so the throw is about half, not a quarter

scenarios.text: An incendiary mortar shell lands one cell from a colonist while a frag shell lands one cell from her squadmate. Both are thrown, she about half as far as he is.
scenarios.expect: accept: bombs throw at full strength and fire and incendiary blasts at half strength, about half the throw

scenarios.text: During a mortar raid on a stocked colony, the player saves while a stack of medicine blown off a storeroom shelf is still in the air, then reloads. After the reload that stack is nowhere on the map.
scenarios.expect: reject: the raid must survive a mid-way reload with no thing in the air lost or duplicated

scenarios.text: A bomb goes off in a storeroom where three colonists stand near an open pit. Stacks off the shelves arc away spinning and several drop into the pit to its floor; one colonist is thrown toward the pit and falls in, and the other two land on the storeroom floor, stunned.
scenarios.expect: accept: anything thrown toward an open pit falls to its floor, goods and people alike; nothing is thrown across

scenarios.text: A colonist crouches one cell west of where a mortar shell lands, with a waist-high barricade line directly behind her to the east. The shell goes off; she is lifted, hits the barricade and comes down on the cell just in front of it, stunned but alive.
scenarios.expect: reject: a throw goes clean over sandbags and barricades; stopping in front of the barricade line is the leaf's own red

scenarios.text: A grenade throws a raider east into a granite wall. He takes an impact hit, then, carrying a little momentum, eases back half a cell west and settles one step off the wall face.
scenarios.expect: reject: a thrown person stops dead at a wall; people never rebound, not even half a step back

scenarios.text: A mortar throws a colonist toward an empty cell three cells away. While she is still in the air a pack muffalo wanders onto that cell, so she sets down on the free cell beside it instead and gets up when her stun ends.
scenarios.expect: reject: a thrown pawn lands on the cell chosen at the blast and is never re-targeted; a flyer re-targeting when the landing cell is taken is a listed false pass

scenarios.text: A raider's tox-gas shell bursts in a colony courtyard. The green cloud spreads, and the two colonists nearest the impact are flung two cells away from it before they start coughing.
scenarios.expect: reject: toxic gas is one of the harmless bursts set to 0; toxic gas throwing is a listed false pass

scenarios.text: A scyther mech is crossing a covered pit trap when a colonist lobs an EMP grenade onto it. The mech is stunned, the pit cover splits and the mech drops to the pit floor.
scenarios.expect: reject: an EMP, smoke or stun burst never breaks a pit cover, even one that hurts mechs

scenarios.text: A frag grenade goes off beside a raider standing at the edge of a one-cell-wide open pit. His three-cell throw carries him over the gap and he lands stunned on the far rim, outside the pit.
scenarios.expect: reject: anything thrown toward an open pit falls to its floor; nothing is thrown across a pit

scenarios.text: A modded weapons locker shows the rifles racked inside it on its sprite. A mortar lands next to it; the locker jolts a little in place and every rifle stays stored in it.
scenarios.expect: reject: anything that draws its contents is open, a drawing locker included, so its rifles scatter like floor goods; only storage that hides what it holds keeps its goods

scenarios.text: A colonist with a fully charged shield belt stands at the edge of a flammable gas cloud when a fire runs into it. The clump next to him bursts; his belt flickers and he stays exactly where he stood while goods around him scatter.
scenarios.expect: reject: a shield belt does not stop a gas clump's one-cell shove; 'the shield belt stops the shove' is a listed false pass

scenarios.text: A mortar shell throws a stack of steel toward a closed wooden door at the end of the storeroom. The stack strikes the door and drops dead on the cell in front of it.
scenarios.expect: reject: thrown goods rebound off walls and closed doors keeping about 70 percent each until spent; stopping at the first barrier is a listed false pass and the stop-dead rule is for people only

scenarios.text: After a blast knocks a stack of medicine onto the floor of a pit, a colonist is told to haul it. He paths straight across the rim, steps down into the pit with no ladder, picks it up and climbs back out.
scenarios.expect: reject: no colonist walks into a pit by ordinary pathing; a colonist enters a pit only by force, and walking in with no ladder is a listed false pass for fetching

scenarios.text: A frag grenade lands on bare ground two cells beside a covered pit, not on it. The pit cover still cracks apart and the raider standing on it falls in.
scenarios.expect: accept: a damaging blast that reaches a cover within its radius, landing on it or beside it, breaks it and whoever is on it falls; 'only a blast centred on the cover breaks it' is a false pass

scenarios.text: A burning gas clump bursts beside a colonist and pushes him one cell onto a covered pit cell. He stands on the cover unhurt and the cover stays whole.
scenarios.expect: accept: a gas clump's one-cell shove is not a throw; a pawn it shoves onto a cover stands on it, the cover whole, and the shove does no damage

scenarios.text: One mortar shell at its normal damage lands on open ground with a rat, a colonist and a 144 kg pack muffalo each standing one cell from the impact on different sides. All three sail through the air and land three cells out, the rat no farther than the muffalo.
scenarios.expect: reject: heavier flies less; one blast throws a rat farther than a colonist and a colonist farther than a muffalo, and every creature thrown the same length is a listed false pass

scenarios.text: A staged Bomb blast of the mortar's radius 2.9 at damage 50 goes off with a rat, a colonist, a muffalo and a thrumbo each one cell away on open ground. The rat lands five cells out, the colonist three, the muffalo two, and the thrumbo does not move.
scenarios.expect: accept: the lightest flies farthest and the heaviest least (rat 5, colonist 3, muffalo 2 at the reference damage) and a thrumbo over the 150 kg creature mass limit is not moved

scenarios.text: The same staged Bomb blast of radius 2.9 is set off twice beside a colonist one cell away, once at damage 50 and once, on a fresh copy, at damage 100. Both times she lands on the same cell three cells out.
scenarios.expect: reject: force is the damage type's force times this blast's damage over the type's normal damage, so at twice the damage she goes farther; doubling the damage changing nothing is the leaf's red

scenarios.text: The radius-2.9 Bomb blast is repeated at damage 100 with the rat, colonist, muffalo and thrumbo one cell away. The colonist now lands five cells out and the muffalo four; the rat lands six cells out, the maximum throw; the thrumbo stays put.
scenarios.expect: accept: at twice the damage each throwable creature goes farther, up to the maximum throw (the rat at the cap is not a failure of scaling), and the thrumbo over 150 kg is still not thrown

scenarios.text: A frag grenade goes off between a squirrel and a 144 kg pack muffalo, each one cell from it. Both are lifted and land the same five cells out on either side.
scenarios.expect: reject: heavier flies less; a muffalo flying as far as a small animal is the leaf's red

scenarios.text: A mortar shell, at the mortar's normal damage, lands one cell from a colonist on open ground. She is pushed a single cell and stays on her feet.
scenarios.expect: reject: a mortar shell beside a colonist throws them about three cells, alive and briefly stunned; a blast at its type's normal damage still throws a colonist three cells

scenarios.text: A modded launcher fires a Bomb-damage shell dealing 25 damage, half the Bomb type's normal 50, with the mortar's radius. It lands one cell from a colonist while a mortar shell lands one cell from her squadmate. She is thrown a shorter way than he is.
scenarios.expect: accept: force is the type's force times this blast's damage over the type's normal damage, so a 25-damage Bomb blast throws less far than a 50-damage mortar

scenarios.text: A grenade goes off with a 60 kg colonist and a 30 kg dog each one cell from it. The colonist lands three cells out; the dog lands only two cells out.
scenarios.expect: reject: heavier flies less, so the lighter dog must fly farther than the colonist, not shorter

scenarios.text: With Mod Settings at their defaults, a mortar shell lands beside the corpse of a 120 kg animal. The corpse is flung three cells in a spinning arc.
scenarios.expect: reject: goods and corpses heavier than the 75 kg goods mass limit are never thrown; a corpse is weighed by the goods limit alone, not the 150 kg creature limit

scenarios.text: The player lowers the creature mass limit in Mod Settings to 20 kg. A grenade goes off between a dead raider (a 60 kg human corpse) and a living 30 kg dog. The corpse flies off spinning while the dog stays where it stood.
scenarios.expect: accept: the creature mass limit weighs living pawns only, so the 30 kg dog is spared, and the corpse, under the 75 kg goods limit, is thrown

scenarios.text: With Mod Settings at their defaults, a frag grenade goes off one cell from a 180 kg rhino. The rhino is lifted and thrown a cell away.
scenarios.expect: reject: a living creature heavier than the 150 kg creature mass limit is never thrown; a rhino at 180 kg does not fly

scenarios.text: The player raises the goods mass limit in Mod Settings to 1000 kg. A grenade goes off beside a thrumbo corpse, and the corpse stays where it lies while lighter stacks around it fly.
scenarios.expect: reject: no body-size rule remains; a corpse is weighed by the goods mass limit alone, so with that limit above its mass the thrumbo corpse is thrown

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands two cells from a Deep Storage weapons locker that hides its rifles, 200 kg with its contents, an empty floor cell behind it. The locker slides one cell away from the blast and every rifle stays inside.
scenarios.expect: accept: a 1x1 closed container at or under the 250 kg container mass limit (not the 75 kg goods limit) slides one cell when the cell behind is free, its goods kept

scenarios.text: The same 200 kg weapons locker with an empty cell behind it is beside the next mortar shell. It does not move off its cell, only shudders in place, because it weighs more than 75 kg.
scenarios.expect: reject: a 1x1 closed container at or under the 250 kg container mass limit slides one cell when the cell behind is free; the 75 kg goods limit does not weigh containers

scenarios.text: A grenade goes off beside a 1x1 modded safe that hides its contents, 300 kg with its silver, an empty floor cell behind it. The safe slides a full cell away from the blast, silver still inside.
scenarios.expect: reject: a closed container heavier than the 250 kg container mass limit only jolts in place; it slides only at or under the limit

scenarios.text: Rifles are hidden in one of the Armoury's secret floor panels, the kind given the opt-in tag. A grenade goes off beside it and the rifles burst out of the panel and scatter across the floor with the loose goods.
scenarios.expect: reject: another mod's hiding container given the opt-in tag, such as the Armoury's secret floor panel, is a closed container and keeps its goods

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands beside one of the Armoury's tagged secret floor panels with rifles hidden in it, on a floor strewn with loose components. The components fly off spinning; every rifle stays hidden in the panel.
scenarios.expect: accept: the Armoury's tagged secret floor panel is a closed container and keeps its goods while loose goods fly

scenarios.text: The player switches 'Sealed crates count as closed containers' off in Mod Settings. A grenade goes off beside a sealed crate of silver, and the silver bursts out of the crate and scatters across the floor.
scenarios.expect: reject: a sealed crate keeps its goods in its own holder, out of every blast's reach whatever the switch says; the switch decides only whether the crate is shoved or jolted

scenarios.text: With 'Sealed crates count as closed containers' switched off in Mod Settings, a mortar shell lands beside a 1x1 sealed crate of components with an empty cell behind it. The crate neither slides nor jolts, and every component stays inside it.
scenarios.expect: accept: sealed crates counted closed off, a crate neither slides nor jolts, and its goods stay in its own holder

scenarios.text: With 'Sealed crates count as closed containers' switched off in Mod Settings, a grenade goes off beside a 1x1 sealed crate with free floor behind it. The crate slides one cell away from the blast, its goods inside.
scenarios.expect: reject: with sealed crates counted closed off, a crate neither slides nor jolts

scenarios.text: A colonist stands one cell from the rim of an open pit when a burning gas clump bursts on her far side. The burst shoves her one cell onto the open pit cell and she drops to the pit floor, with no burns or blast wounds.
scenarios.expect: accept: a gas clump's one-cell shove is not a throw but is force; a pawn it shoves onto an open pit cell falls in, and the shove does no damage

scenarios.text: A raider stands beside an open pit when a burning gas clump bursts behind him and shoves him one cell onto the open pit cell. He stays standing on the open pit cell as though it were floor, then walks off.
scenarios.expect: reject: a pawn a gas shove pushes onto an open pit cell falls in; nothing stands over an open pit

scenarios.text: Two colonists stand beside two pits, one open and one covered. A burning gas cloud goes off and its clumps shove each one cell onto the pit beside them. Both drop to the pit floors; the second breaks through the cover, which lies in pieces.
scenarios.expect: reject: the open-pit colonist falls in, but a pawn a gas shove pushes onto a cover stands on it, the cover whole

scenarios.text: A long cloud of the Cauldron's vent gas is lit by a fire at its edge. A clump bursts beside a colonist and, the cloud being large and burning hot, shoves her three cells across the room.
scenarios.expect: reject: a gas clump shoves a person one cell, unhurt; gas clump bursts are not scaled up

scenarios.text: The player switches 'blast power from damage' off in Mod Settings. A 100-damage Bomb blast of the mortar's radius throws a colonist one cell from it five cells, while an ordinary mortar shell throws her squadmate three.
scenarios.expect: reject: with blast power from damage off, a throw ignores the blast's damage, so both are thrown the same

scenarios.text: A grav-ram, whose own creature mass limit is 216 kg, strikes one cell from a 240 kg thrumbo. The thrumbo is thrown two cells along the blast.
scenarios.expect: reject: a weapon with its own creature limit throws pawns under that limit only; the thrumbo at 240 kg is over the grav-ram's 216 kg

scenarios.text: A modded Bomb shell dealing 200 damage, four times a mortar's, lands one cell from a 240 kg thrumbo at default settings. The huge blast lifts the thrumbo and throws it a cell.
scenarios.expect: reject: a thrumbo over the 150 kg creature mass limit is not thrown at all, whatever the blast's damage

scenarios.text: An incendiary mortar shell lands one cell from a colonist while a frag mortar shell lands one cell from her squadmate. Both are thrown the same three cells.
scenarios.expect: reject: fire and incendiary blasts throw at half strength, about half the throw; with fire's normal damage as its reference, fire keeps its half

scenarios.text: A modder's heavy mortar shell deals 100 Bomb damage, twice a vanilla shell, with the same radius. The build takes each shell's normal damage from that shell's own def, so every shell reads a damage ratio of 1.0. With Mod Settings at their defaults the heavy shell lands beside a colonist and she flies three cells over the sandbags, stunned, exactly as a vanilla mortar would throw her; the rat beside her flies five.
scenarios.expect: reject: force is the damage type's force times this blast's damage over that type's normal damage (Bomb 50), so a 100-damage Bomb blast is ratio 2.0 and throws the colonist farther (5 cells); a bigger blast that throws no farther is the named failure

scenarios.text: One grenade goes off five cells from a rat, a colonist, a muffalo and a thrumbo standing in a row of equal distance. The rat sails five cells, the colonist three, the muffalo three, and the thrumbo does not move; the journal reads too_heavy_creature for the thrumbo.
scenarios.expect: reject: heavier flies less, a colonist must fly farther than a muffalo (3 vs 2); the muffalo thrown as far as the colonist reads as creatures thrown alike

scenarios.text: An incendiary shell at Flame's ordinary damage of 10 lands beside a raider. The build scales every blast's force by its damage over 50, the Bomb reference, before applying fire's half, so the raider's throw works out under one cell and he is not moved; fire spreads around him. A frag grenade at 50 Bomb damage nearby throws another raider three cells.
scenarios.expect: reject: a damage type's normal damage is its own default (Flame 10), so fire at its own normal damage keeps half strength, about half the bomb throw; fire throwing nobody fails 'fire at half'

scenarios.text: The player lowers the creature mass limit in Mod Settings to 50 kg. A grenade goes off between a living 60 kg colonist and the 60 kg corpse of a raider she shot earlier. Neither moves; the journal reads too_heavy_creature for both.
scenarios.expect: reject: the creature mass limit weighs living pawns only; a corpse is weighed only by the 75 kg goods limit, so the 60 kg corpse must fly (the colonist staying is right)

scenarios.text: A grenade lands beside a modded grazing animal of 120 kg whose body size is 2.8. The animal stays where it stands, and the journal says it was spared for a body size over 2.5; a 140 kg muffalo-like animal of body size 2.4 beside it is thrown two cells.
scenarios.expect: reject: no body-size rule remains; a living creature is spared only above the 150 kg creature mass limit, so the 120 kg animal must be thrown (farther than the 140 kg one)

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands two cells from a 1x1 modded weapons locker that hides its rifles, total 180 kg with its contents, and the floor behind it is free. The rifles stay inside; the locker does not slide but jolts in place, because its mass is over the 75 kg mass limit.
scenarios.expect: reject: a closed container is weighed by the 250 kg container mass limit, not the 75 kg goods limit; at 180 kg with a free cell behind it slides one cell

scenarios.text: A grenade goes off beside a 1x1 hiding weapons locker of 200 kg standing on the rim of an open pit. The locker is shoved one cell into the pit and drops to its floor with its rifles still inside, and a colonist can later haul the rifles back out.
scenarios.expect: reject: a shoved closed container never goes into a pit; with the pit behind it, it jolts in place

scenarios.text: The build gives the opt-in closed tag to the Armoury's secret floor panel and also to a modded fridge that draws its meals on its shelves, so that food survives raids. A grenade in the kitchen leaves the panel's stash and the fridge's meals in place, while loose floor goods fly.
scenarios.expect: reject: anything that draws its contents is open, period; no opt-in tag goes on a def that draws its contents, so the fridge's meals must scatter (the tagged panel holding is right)

scenarios.text: The player turns off 'Sealed crates count as closed containers'. A grenade goes off beside a sealed crate; the crate stays still and its goods burst out and scatter across the storeroom like loose goods, which the player reads as the switch working.
scenarios.expect: reject: a sealed crate keeps its goods in its own holder out of every blast's reach whatever the switch says; the switch decides only whether the crate is shoved or jolted (off: neither)

scenarios.text: A burning gas clump goes off beside a raider standing next to a covered pit trap and shoves him one cell onto the cover. The cover gives way under the push and he falls to the pit floor, unhurt by the burst.
scenarios.expect: reject: a gas clump's shove onto a cover leaves the pawn standing on it, the cover whole; a gas burst never breaks a cover

scenarios.text: With 'Sealed crates count as closed containers' off, a mortar shell lands two cells from a 1x1 sealed crate with free floor behind it and from a hiding weapons locker of 150 kg. The locker slides one cell away; the crate neither slides nor jolts, and its goods stay inside.
scenarios.expect: accept: off, a sealed crate neither slides nor jolts and keeps its goods in its own holder; the locker under the 250 kg container limit with a free cell behind slides one

scenarios.text: A long flammable gas cloud over a pit yard catches. One clump's burst shoves a colonist one cell onto an open pit cell and she falls to its floor with no blast injuries; the next clump shoves a raider onto a pit cover, where he stands, the cover unbroken.
scenarios.expect: accept: a gas clump's one-cell shove is force: onto an open pit the pawn falls in (forced in, not careless), onto a cover the pawn stands, the cover whole
